svg.title: louis-agent.pack.recipes: searching, then reading a recipe

g.text: it has words but no recipe
it has no data, but shows a recipe
asks several sites, some kept for pages
a numbered list, framed as untrusted
reads the kept copy, and no browser
is it a page already found to have no
KeepAsync, if it's from a table site
ExcludeAsync, so nobody opens it again
says there's no recipe on the page
the page's text, cut and labelled

text.tspan: a page with no recipe data comes back as its text, labelled as such.
